message.content:
# App Screenshot Description

This is a mobile transit/commute app (appears to be an Indian bus-tracking app, likely Chennai-focused) showing a home screen.

## Status Bar & Top Map Area
- **Status bar:** "Of stel" text (partially cut), time **3:48**, small notification icons (an orange circle, purple "Z", blue and teal icons, wrench), Wi‑Fi, signal bars, "0.60 kB/s 4G", battery at **57%**.
- **Map:** A light Google Maps view (Google logo watermark at left) showing streets like **Thirumalai Street** (vertical label) and "Bharathi Salai". A **blue circular pedestrian/walking icon with a white walking figure** sits at top center with a small blue location dot below it. A Tamil-language bus stop label is visible.
- Text label **"SRM Easwari Engineering College"** on the map.

## Location Banner
- Over a pastel illustrated background (light blue sky, green bushes/trees at bottom):
  - **"You are in ↗ Ramapuram."** (Ramapuram underlined)
  - **"No buses available around you."**
  - Dark navy, bold text, centered.

## Search Bar
- Large pill-shaped button with a **magenta-to-red/orange gradient**, white text: **Search "Bus Stops"** with a white magnifying glass icon at right.

## Transport Mode Carousel
- White rounded cards with 3D vehicle illustrations:
  - **Bus** (white/green bus)
  - **Metro** (white train on track)
  - **Train** (white train)
  - **Auto** (yellow/green auto-rickshaw)
  - A fifth partially visible card cut off at right edge.

## Promotional Banner (Yellow Card)
- Bright yellow rounded card:
  - Huge black **"₹1"**
  - **"₹1 Rupee Ticket"** and **"⚡ 1-Click Booking"** in dark navy
  - **"Powered by Chalo"** (Chalo in a stylized underlined wordmark)
- Right side: a **phone mockup** (dark frame) showing a white bus on blue, with a ticket card reading:
  - Red circular **CUMTA UPI logo** (red rounded icon with white mark)
  - **"CUMTA UPI — Powered by Chalo"**, "₹1" at top right
  - Blue button: **"GET TICKET"** in white caps
- Carousel dots below: 4 dots, second one active (dark).

## Track Your Buses Section
- Heading: **"Track your buses"**
- **"Nearby Stop:"** with blue **"Show all ›"** pill button
- Underlined link: **"Ramapuram Srm University"**
- White card: gray label **"Towards RAMAPURAM"**; a bus route chip **"S26"** (dark red text on pale yellow rounded square), **"To Valasaravakkam"**, a Wi‑Fi-like live icon, and a green mono-style badge **"15 MIN"**. Below, partially visible: another "S26" chip with gray **"EXP"** and **"SCHEDULED"** tags.

## Bottom Navigation Bar
- White rounded pill with 5 items:
  - **Home** (red/orange flag-like logo icon — the Chalo logo, a red angular shape)
  - **Tickets** (gray ticket icon)
  - **BUS TICKET** — center, raised blue/purple gradient circular button with bus icon in brackets
  - **Pass** (gray circular pass icon)
  - **Account** (gray person icon)
- A home-indicator bar at very bottom.

## Color Palette
Light blue map, pastel green/yellow illustration, magenta-red gradient search bar, bright yellow promo card, blue accents (links, buttons), dark navy text, white cards on light gray background.
